Title: Cyrena.Angular - AngularPlugin (Rigid API)
Summary: Semantic Kernel plugin for Angular development with rigid, opinionated folder structure. The AI provides only artifact name and optional feature name — the plugin decides exact paths.
Content:
## AngularPlugin — Rigid Structure API

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Angular.Services`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Angular`

### Design Philosophy

The Angular plugin enforces a **rigid, opinionated folder structure**. The AI does NOT choose paths. It provides:
1. The artifact name (e.g., `UserProfile`, `UserService`)
2. Optionally, a feature name (e.g., `users`, `admin`)

The plugin computes the exact destination automatically.

### Core Helper: `GetTypedFolder(string type, string? inFeature)`

Resolves the correct folder for any artifact type:

- **If `inFeature` is null/empty:** `src/app/{type}/`
- **If `inFeature` is provided:** `src/app/features/{feature}/{type}/`

| Artifact Type | Global Path | Feature Path |
|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| Component | `src/app/components/` | `src/app/features/{f}/components/` |
| Service | `src/app/services/` | `src/app/features/{f}/services/` |
| Guard | `src/app/guards/` | `src/app/features/{f}/guards/` |
| Pipe | `src/app/pipes/` | `src/app/features/{f}/pipes/` |
| Directive | `src/app/directives/` | `src/app/features/{f}/directives/` |
| Model | `src/app/models/` | `src/app/features/{f}/models/` |
| Interceptor | `src/app/interceptors/` | `src/app/features/{f}/interceptors/` |
| Resolver | `src/app/resolvers/` | `src/app/features/{f}/resolvers/` |

### Kernel Functions

#### `create_feature`
Creates a feature module under `src/app/features/` with standard subfolders. Also creates the directories on disk.
- **Param:** `name` — Feature name in camelCase/kebab-case
- **Creates:** `src/app/features/{name}/` with `components/`, `services/`, `guards/`, `pipes/`, `directives/`, `models/`, `interceptors/`, `resolvers/`

#### `create_component`
Creates a standalone component using `ng generate component`. Sets `WorkingDirectory` to the appropriate components folder so the CLI creates files in the correct location.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase component name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name. Null = global `src/app/components/`
- **Behavior:**
  1. Computes the components folder (global or feature)
  2. Runs `ng generate component {kebab-name}` with `WorkingDirectory` set to that folder
  3. Indexes the newly created files into the DevelopPlan
- **Returns:** The `.ts` file as the primary `DevelopFile`

#### `create_service`
Creates an injectable service using `ng generate service`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase service name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate service {kebab-name}` in the appropriate services folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_guard`
Creates a route guard using `ng generate guard`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase guard name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate guard {kebab-name}` in the appropriate guards folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_pipe`
Creates a custom pipe using `ng generate pipe`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase pipe name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate pipe {kebab-name}` in the appropriate pipes folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_directive`
Creates a custom directive using `ng generate directive`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase directive name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate directive {kebab-name}` in the appropriate directives folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_model`
Creates a TypeScript model/interface file. **Does NOT use `ng generate`** — models are simple TypeScript files created directly in the plan.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase model name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name

#### `create_interceptor`
Creates an HTTP interceptor using `ng generate interceptor`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase interceptor name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate interceptor {kebab-name}` in the appropriate interceptors folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_resolver`
Creates a route resolver using `ng generate resolver`.
- **Param:** `name` — PascalCase resolver name
- **Param:** `inFeature` — Optional feature name
- **Behavior:** Runs `ng generate resolver {kebab-name}` in the appropriate resolvers folder, then indexes the created `.ts` file into the DevelopPlan.

#### `create_stylesheet`
Creates a global stylesheet in `src/styles/`.
- **Param:** `name` — Stylesheet name
- **Param:** `ext` — `css`, `scss`, or `less` (default: `scss`)

#### `create_environment`
Creates an environment file in `src/environments/`.
- **Param:** `name` — File name without extension

#### `create_asset`
Creates an asset file in `src/assets/`.
- **Param:** `name` — File name with extension

#### `create_e2e`
Creates an e2e test file in `e2e/`.
- **Param:** `name` — File name with extension

#### `create_public_file`
Creates a public file in `public/`.
- **Param:** `name` — File name with extension

#### `build`
Runs `ng build --configuration={configuration}`.
- **Param:** `configuration` — `production` or `development` (default: `production`)
- **Returns:** `success`, `exitCode`, `output`, `errors`

### Internal Helpers

#### `CreateNgArtifact(string folderType, string schematic, string name, string? inFeature)`
Shared helper for all `ng generate` artifact creation. Computes the target folder, ensures the directory exists on disk, runs `ng generate {schematic} {kebab-name}` with `WorkingDirectory` set to the target folder, then indexes all matching `.ts` files into the DevelopPlan.

#### `RunNgCommand(string arguments, string workingDirectory)`
Runs an `ng` CLI command with the specified arguments and working directory. Captures stdout/stderr, logs output via `_context`, and returns a `ToolResult<string[]>`.

#### `CreateArtifactInFolder(DevelopFolder folder, string name, string? typeSuffix, string? fileSuffix)`
Manual file creation helper used for artifacts that don't have an `ng generate` schematic (e.g., models). Creates an empty file entry in the DevelopPlan.

### Removed Functions

The following functions from the previous flexible API have been removed:
- `create_component_in_folder` — No longer needed; path is computed
- `create_service_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_guard_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_pipe_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_directive_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_model_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_interceptor_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_resolver_in_folder` — No longer needed
- `create_folder_in_app` — No longer needed; use `create_feature` + artifact functions
- `create_ts_in_folder` — Removed; generic file creation is root-only
- `create_html_in_folder` — Removed
- `create_css_in_folder` — Removed
- `create_scss_in_folder` — Removed
- `create_less_in_folder` — Removed
- `create_json_in_folder` — Removed

### File Naming

All artifacts use kebab-case file names derived from PascalCase input via `ToKebabCase()`.

| Input | Output File |
|-------|-------------|
| `UserProfile` | `user-profile.component.ts` |
| `UserService` | `user.service.ts` |
| `AuthGuard` | `auth.guard.ts` |
| `User` (model) | `user.model.ts` |
